annotations.title: Read a UDCPR regulation or town

description: Use this to read one result of search in full: a UDCPR regulation or table in its own words as notified, what a town is under UDCPR with the figures for a common plot there, or a term in plain language with UDCPR's own definition. Returns id, title, text, url to cite, and metadata.

id.description: an id from search, such as udcpr/6-2-6, udcpr/table-6-g, towns/kolhapur or glossary/carpet
